text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.
seg_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland <SEG:2> call themselves Inuit <SEG:1> in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), <SEG:3> a Greenlander, in Greenland.
